# Cozy Corner

> Cozy coquette Christmas coloring pages, C2C crochet charts, printables, phone wallpapers and custom pieces made from your photo. Available in English, Spanish and Italian. Orders and quotes through the request form on the site.

## Pages
- [Free Christmas coloring pages](https://cozycornerprints.github.io/free-christmas-coloring-pages/): 3 free A4 pages (gingerbread house, cocoa mug, teddy bear), PDF download, no sign up
- [Christmas C2C crochet charts](https://cozycornerprints.github.io/christmas-crochet-charts/): 8 charts in one A4 PDF with color keys, 5.90 EUR
- [Christmas coloring book](https://cozycornerprints.github.io/cozy-christmas-coloring-book/): 29 bold and easy drawings for adults and teens, paperback coming soon on Amazon
- [Printable Christmas gift tags and cards](https://cozycornerprints.github.io/christmas-printables/): gift tags, cards, jar labels, place cards, A4
- [Christmas phone wallpapers](https://cozycornerprints.github.io/christmas-phone-wallpapers/): free on Pinterest, custom ones 15 EUR for 1, 49 EUR for 5
- [Custom from your photo](https://cozycornerprints.github.io/custom/): coloring page, little coloring book for kids, embroidery pattern, C2C crochet chart or wallpaper, price on request
- [Request form](https://cozycornerprints.github.io/request/)

Spanish: https://cozycornerprints.github.io/es/ · Italian: https://cozycornerprints.github.io/it/
